newsitem.title: POLAND: BPH, NFI 9 SIGN INVESTMENT BANKING DEAL.
newsitem.headline: BPH, NFI 9 SIGN INVESTMENT BANKING DEAL.

text.p: Polish Bank Przemyslowo- Handlowy (BPH) has signed a contract with National Investment Fund (NFI) No. 9 to cooperate in investment banking and commercial banking activities, BPH said in a statement.
NFI No.9 is one of 15 funds in Poland's mass privatisation programme in which each of Poland's 28 million adults can buy one unit later to be exchanged for shares in each of the funds.
The funds are run by domestic and international management firms and group more than 500 firms undergoing privatisation.
The units, which started trading on the Warsaw bourse on July 15, have been on sale since November 1995 and will be offered until November.
